page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred. Engraving with banner in the middle; imprint below. Library stamp at lower right and digitiser credit at the foot are not transcribed.
page.notes: Woodcut engraving between the title lines and the imprint: a standing figure with a banner reading "PALLADIUM GELRO ZVTPHAN" and several coats of arms. A round stamp at upper right is an ownership seal and is not transcribed. The date line is partly covered by a library stamp reading "BIBLIOTECA NAZ. ROMA VITTORIO EMANUELE"; the year is read as MDCLIIII, with the last numerals partly obscured. The title line "JOANNIS DALLÆI" has a damaged letter in "DALLÆI" (the Æ is partly worn).
